The user wants to know who was the second president of the International Society for Soil Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering (ISSMGE). Let me search for this information.

I found a Scribd document titled "Second President of ISSMGE Insights" which references Karl Terzaghi as "Honorary President International Society of Soil Mechanics and Foundation Engineering". But let me search more specifically for the list of presidents.

Based on the ISSMGE history page, the list of presidents shows:

1. 1936 – 1957: K. Terzaghi (USA)
2. 1957 – 1961: A. W. Skempton (UK)

So the second president was A. W. Skempton.
The second president of ISSMGE was **A. W. Skempton** (1957–1961).
The answer has been written. A. W. Skempton was the second president of ISSMGE (1957-1961), after Karl Terzaghi who was the first president.
Done. The second president of the International Society for Soil Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering was **A. W. Skempton**, who served from 1957 to 1961, succeeding Karl Terzaghi.
